# GrowthPilot

> Zero-dependency Python CLI, MCP server, Agent Skill, and GitHub Action that audits codebases or live URLs across 6 pillars and 18 deterministic SEO, GEO (`llms.txt`), Schema.org, and CRO rules, then generates ready-to-deploy marketing assets.

## Official Multi-Page Website

- [Home](https://codesphere-u.github.io/growthpilot/): Overview, split CTA installer (`uv`, `npx skills`, `mcp`, `ci`), and quick audit preview.
- [Interactive Studio](https://codesphere-u.github.io/growthpilot/studio.html): Live CRO AI-slop analyzer, instant `llms.txt` / Schema.org JSON-LD builder, and 12-output explorer.
- [Verified Proof](https://codesphere-u.github.io/growthpilot/proof.html): `funagigs.com` before/after (`40 -> 100`) case study and comparison table.
- [Documentation](https://codesphere-u.github.io/growthpilot/docs.html): Quickstart installation, AI agent skill setup, stdio MCP configuration, GitHub Actions SARIF gating, and CLI flags.
- [18 Rules & Technical FAQ](https://codesphere-u.github.io/growthpilot/rules.html): Interactive rubric table (`MKT001`–`MKT018`), pillar point breakdown, and technical FAQ.
- [Full Knowledge Pack (`llms-full.txt`)](https://codesphere-u.github.io/growthpilot/llms-full.txt): Complete CLI reference, 6 MCP tool definitions, scoring model, and FAQs.

## GitHub Source & Documentation

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/codesphere-u/growthpilot): Source code, MIT license, GitHub Action (`codesphere-u/growthpilot@v1`), and v1.4.2 release.
- [Getting Started Guide](https://github.com/codesphere-u/growthpilot/blob/main/docs/GETTING_STARTED.md): Founder, marketer, developer, and framework deployment tutorials.
- [MCP & AI Agents Setup](https://github.com/codesphere-u/growthpilot/blob/main/docs/MCP_AND_AGENTS.md): Claude Code, Cursor, Antigravity, Codex, and SARIF CI integration.
- [Architecture & Rubric](https://github.com/codesphere-u/growthpilot/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): Deterministic pipeline internals, Next.js chunk FAQ scanner, and security controls.
